narrative: okay so, operator called me over, press two, the top, no, the press refuses to cycle and the light curtain keeps faulting. it was throwing the oh seven alarm. found it in the end, light curtain misaligned and lens dirty. so I lock out the machine. then I clean the emitter and receiver lenses. then I realign the light curtain using the alignment indicators. and I run the safety function test and record it. after that get supervisor sign-off before returning to production. it's running fine now.
symptoms: Press refuses to cycle; light curtain keeps faulting; alarm 07 / ERR-S07
root_cause: Light curtain misaligned and lens dirty
steps: Lock out machine; clean emitter and receiver lenses; realign light curtain using alignment indicators; run and record safety-function test; obtain supervisor sign-off before returning to production.
safety_warnings: Lock out the hydraulic press before working. Complete and record the safety-function test. Obtain supervisor sign-off before returning to production.

narrative: CNV-02: product pushed off the edge; belt drifts to one side. Cause: build-up on an idler roller pushing the belt off line. Fix: stop and lock out the conveyor; find the idler with build-up; clean the roller surface and check it spins freely; square the roller to the frame. Tools: scraper, spirit level, spanner set. OK, returned to production.
